info.name: 7LFreight API — Rates & Booking
info.description:
Test collection for 7LFreight REST API (https://restapi.my7l.com/api/v1/docs).

Workflow:
1. Run '1. Login' once — the access token is saved automatically to {{accessToken}} and reused by every other request (7L enforces a DAILY token-issuance quota, so do NOT login before every call).
2. Run '2a. Carrier Lookup' to get CarrierHash values — the first hash is auto-saved to {{carrierHash}}.
3. Run one of the rate requests (LTL / Air / Ocean).
4. For LTL: the first returned rate can be saved as a quote via '4. Save Quote (LTL)' using {{rateId}}.
5. Booking/dispatch uses the Dispatch object (see '5. Book / Dispatch') — endpoint access must be enabled by 7L for your account.

Set {{username}} and {{password}} in the collection variables before starting.

request.description: Authenticates and returns an access token. IMPORTANT: 7L enforces a per-account DAILY quota on token issuance — reuse the token until it expires, then use Refresh Token.
Exchange an expired token for a new one without consuming the daily login quota.
Lists the LTL/common carriers configured on your account. Each result includes the CarrierHash needed for rate requests and whether the carrier supports ElectronicDispatch (i.e. API booking).
List of accessorial codes (liftgate, residential, etc.) usable in accessorialsList[] on rate and dispatch requests.

exec: console.log('Carrier:', results[0].Name, '| Total:', results[0].Total, '| Transit days:', results[0].TransitDays);
if (rid) { pm.collectionVariables.set('rateId', rid); console.log('rateId saved:', rid); }

query.description: false returns a RateId so the quote can be saved
JSON array — Reference (B). weightType: each|total. dimType: CTN|PLT|CRT|CON|CYL|DRM|ENV|BOX|BDL. class: 50–500 freight class.

request.description: Door-to-door LTL rate for ONE carrier (identified by carrierHash). Response: Total, TransitDays, QuoteNumber, RateBreakdown (linehaul, fuel surcharge, accessorials). Optional: accessorialsList[]=LFO etc. (codes from 2b).

query.description: 3-letter IATA. For Door-to-X use originCity/State/Zipcode instead
3-letter IATA. For X-to-Door use destinationCity/State/Zipcode instead

request.description: Domestic expedite air. Door-to-Door: pass origin+destination City/State/Zipcode. Airport-to-Door: originAirport + destination address. Door-to-Airport: origin address + destinationAirport. Optional filters: airlineCodeList[], contractRates, TSAPickupAgents, airlineRateType[] (ALL|BULK|ULD|SCR).
International airport-to-airport rates. Check exact parameter list in Swagger (#/International) — structure mirrors expedite air.
LCL ocean rates. Get carrierHash from GET /database/lclaccount and port codes from GET /tools/ports.

Persists a previously fetched LTL rate as a quote (201 Created). Requires the RateId returned by 3a when strictResult=false. The saved quote's QuoteNumber can then be used as a referenceNumber (type Q) when booking.

request.description:
Booking uses the Dispatch object (Reference C: https://restapi.my7l.com/dist/referenceDispatch.json).

IMPORTANT:
- ALWAYS keep testOnly: true while testing — it validates the booking without dispatching to the carrier.
- The dispatch/booking endpoints are hidden in the public Swagger and must be ENABLED for your account by 7L — if you get 401/403 with a valid token, email development@7LFreight.com to get booking API access and confirm the exact endpoint path for your account (LTL dispatch vs expco/book).
- referenceNumbers types: S=shipper ref, C=consignee ref, T=third party ref, P=PO number, Q=quote number (from step 4).
Status code definitions for LTL tracking. Actual tracking endpoint: GET /ltl/ltltracking (hidden in public spec) and GET /expco/{BOLNumber}/track.
